Introduction

Mitsuyuki Amaru is a Japanese singer under JYP Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group KickFlip.

Amaru began his idol journey by training with YG Japan but eventually left the agency. In 2021, he participated in the survival show Loud, where he placed third and earned a spot as an official member of JYP Entertainment's upcoming boy group.
